name: Short Cut Garden Veggie Rice Bowl with Spicy Tuna, Tomatoes, Avocado & Salsa Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Squeeze rice pouches to separate grains, then tear a two-inch opening at the top of each to vent. Place both pouches in the microwave and heat on high until warmed through, about 2 1/2 minutes. Carefully remove from microwave and set aside to cool slightly.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (8.8 oz) pouch garden vegetable rice, pre-cooked

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and halve tomatoes.
Wash, dry, halve, and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
To serve, divide rice between bowls, then top with tuna, tomatoes, and avocado. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (2.6 oz) pouch seasoned tuna, jalapeño flavor
⅓ cup creamy salsa ranch dressing
